verdict.rationale: MX ships a dedicated Account Owner Identification product that connects to the end user's financial account and retrieves account-holder information such as name and address, which directly serves owner-matching. The docs describe it only briefly, and contact data such as phone or email is not explicitly named. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of contact fields (email/phone), detail on returned fields or matching support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: With Account Owner Identification, you can connect to an end user's financial account to retrieve information such as their name and address.
